321 / 321S: Cortech Summit Veldura Lounge Chair
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-321-summit-veldura-lounge-chair
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/endurance/summit-veldura-lounge-chair/
Spec sheet: 320 / 321
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Summit Veldura Lounge Chair – 321 / 321S
Current H1: Cortech Summit Lounge Chair with Veldura - One-Piece Rotationally Molded - Model 321
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded Lounge Chair with a Veldura Soft-Touch Finish and an Optional Ballast Door
Current subtitle: Cortech 321 Summit Veldura Lounge Chair with Veldura Soft-Touch Exterior
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Summit Veldura Lounge Chair is a molded lounge chair with a calm, residential look for patient rooms, dayrooms, lounges, and group spaces in behavioral healthcare and other secure settings. The Veldura soft-touch surface adds comfort and warmth without giving up durability.
The chair is rotationally molded in one piece from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no steel or wood components. It can be weighted at the factory, or the 321S can be filled with sandbags on site through a ballast door. The Summit Veldura Lounge Chair is rated for outdoor use.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Finish: Veldura soft-touch exterior that contrasts with the molded base
Dimensions: 29”W×59”D×35”H
Weight: 50 lbs
Weighting: Factory sand ballasting optional; the 321S has a ballast door for adding sandbags on site that closes with tamper-resistant screws. Do not use loose sand
Outdoor Use: Rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Passes UL 94 HB
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD Gold
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
321 – Veldura: Without ballast door
321S – Veldura with Ballast Door: Ballast door for adding sandbags on site
Installation and Options
Weighting: Factory weighted, or add sandbags on site through the ballast door on the 321S; do not use loose sand. Hardware bit size is T27
[H2] Applications
The Summit Veldura Lounge Chair suits rooms that need comfortable, durable seating that is hard to break or tamper with.
Typical applications include:
Patient rooms, dayrooms, and lounges in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Group rooms and visitor areas in residential treatment centers
Other secure settings that want a calm, residential look
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Summit Series
The Cortech Summit Series is a line of molded seating and tables with a calm, residential look, made for behavioral healthcare facilities and other secure settings. Most Summit seating comes in a standard molded finish or with a Veldura soft-touch exterior.
The Summit Series includes:
Chairs: Guest Chair (300 / 301), Accent Chair (310 / 311), and Lounge Chair (320 / 321)
Stools: Summit Stool (330 / 331)
Tables: Side Table (342 / 343), Mid-Range Table (353 / 354), and All Purpose Table (361 / 363 / 364)
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (61 characters): Cortech Summit Veldura Lounge Chair - 321 / 321S at Anchortex
Meta description (156 characters): Shop the Cortech Summit Veldura Lounge Chair. A one-piece molded chair with a Veldura soft-touch finish and an optional ballast door, rated for outdoor use.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Summit Series" is a new section for the Summit chairs, stools, and tables. It is the same on each Summit page.
H1: Cortech calls it the Summit Veldura Lounge Chair. I took out the extra words from your current title and added the 321S.
Weight: your variants are set to 255 lbs, which looks like a placeholder. The Cortech spec sheet gives 50 lbs for the Summit Lounge Chair and no separate weight for the Veldura version, so I used 50 lbs.
Dimensions: your current page says 29”H×27”W×29”D, which are the Summit Accent Chair dimensions. The Cortech spec sheet says 35”H×29”W×59”D for the lounge chair, so I used those.
Your current page says "Model 320S has a ballast door." I used 321S, the Veldura model on the Cortech spec sheet.
Flammability: the Cortech spec sheet says the chair passes UL 94 HB. The Cortech web page also says CAL 133, but the spec sheet does not, so I used UL 94 HB only.
Antimicrobial: the Cortech spec sheet says "Infused with CORx Antibacterial" and tested to ISO 22196. I used the ISO 22196 test result.
Bolt-down: Cortech has bolt-down plate instructions for this chair, fitted at the ballast door. They do not say whether the plate is sold separately, so I left floor mounting out.
Outdoor use: the FAQ on the Cortech product page says the Summit Veldura Lounge Chair is rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized, so I added it to the description.
Product images: the page has five images, including two Summit color charts. The Cortech product page has photos of the Summit Veldura Lounge Chair in all 18 colors and a photo with a Summit Side Table. Would you like me to add them?
